title: Dependable and Deployable Artificial Intelligence for Robotics - PhD
institution: UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Dependable and Deployable AI for Robotics (CDT-D2AIR)
about: Four-year PhD programme jointly offered by Heriot-Watt University and the University of Edinburgh, starting September 2027. Students define their PhD projects and supervisory teams during Year 1. Applications received by 27 November 2026 are considered in the first round.
requirements: All reference letters must be received by the application deadline
